card.title: Impossible Currency
card.instruction: Price every favor in symbolic acts, imaginary resources, or promises that cannot be measured normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fix the kettle for a spoonful of yesterday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I give you yesterday?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with the five minutes you wasted this morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then leave it overnight. I can wait for the currency to mature.

mechanism: A charges past time for kettle repair and adjusts when the offered time has not yet become yesterday.
confusable: Unlike a merely whimsical fee, the impossible currency must govern the negotiation consistently.
comparison: Time matures overnight, unlike the ladder scene's negotiated shadow hours and surrendered fear.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
